Overview.Name: Bheemani Naresh Mudhiraj
Overview.Preference_Notes: Results first – include non-veg as needed for best results

Early_Morning (optional): Option 3: Plain curd (1 small bowl ~120 g)
Meal_1: Option 1: Whole egg omelette (4 eggs) + any 1 fruit (apple, banana, orange, papaya or berries)
Option 2: Paneer cubes (200 g) + any 1 fruit (apple, banana, orange, papaya or berries)
Option 3: Rice rawa upma (1 bowl ~150 g) + paneer cubes (100 g) + any 1 fruit (apple, banana, orange, papaya or berries)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken breast curry or fry (150 g) & rasam
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry or fry (150 g) & rasam
Option 3: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & mutton curry or fry (150 g) & rasam
Meal_3: Option 1: Curd rice (200 g) & chicken fry (200 g) + any 1 fruit (apple, banana, orange, papaya or berries)
Option 2: Curd rice (200 g) & paneer fry (150 g) + any 1 fruit (apple, banana, orange, papaya or berries)
Option 3: Curd rice (200 g) & mutton fry (200 g) + any 1 fruit (apple, banana, orange, papaya or berries)

Notes_and_Tips: Use only ghee, butter, or coconut oil in small quantities for cooking. Avoid sunflower oil or any seed oils.
If the diet is not followed on one day, skip Meal 2 the next day.
During social gatherings eat protein foods first before rice or snacks.
Avoid dal and dal-based foods such as idly, dosa, and vada.
